title: Dragging Tasks onto Activity Switcher does not work if multiple Windows are open
line: Dragging a task with several windows onto an activity in the Activity Manager sidebar now moves all of its windows there, or also shows them there.
explanation: When an app has several windows, the task manager shows one grouped task, and the drag data of a group was left empty (a FIXME in TaskGroupingProxyModel), so whoever received the drop got no window ids. The Activity Manager sidebar showed its drop zones but had nothing to move, even where single windows worked. The group now puts the ids of all its windows in its drag data, under a group mime type tied to the same model, and WaylandTasksModel::winIdsFromMimeData() reads them back, so every window of the group is moved or copied.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: put the window ids of grouped tasks in their drag data

Dragging a grouped task carried no window ids, so dropping it on another
activity in the Activity Manager sidebar did nothing even where a single
window works. The group now lists the ids of its windows in the drag data.

BUG: 450341
